sections: Read Manufacturer/Device ID Quad IO Figure41
sources.figure41_note: The diagram places the24-bit address before the8-bit F0 mode and four dummy cycles; nearby prose orders these inconsistently. The implemented frame follows Figure41.

sources.document: Reviewed R10 pin_table.tsv, DS12110 Rev8 Tables9/11/13/14 citations

clock_policy: Require the current HSI64/HCLK64 selectors and divisors. Leave selectors unchanged; divide the serial clock by64 to nominal1MHz. No physical frequency or oscillator accuracy is asserted.
timing_workaround: ES0392 2.7.4 is applied with pins parked and NCS high, using an interrupt-masked native primitive with consecutive CCR/CCR/CR stores. Clear the residual CCR and explicitly clear/set EN for2.7.3 before exposing AF pins. Object-code ordering does not qualify actual bus-cycle timing.
read_only_policy: Only05/35/15/9F/5A/94 read frames from a fixed descriptor table; addresses zero, finite lengths <=8, no flash DR writes, reset/wake/WREN/program/erase/status writes, DMA, interrupts, auto-poll or memory-mapped access.
cleanup_policy: Raise NCS using its GPIO ODR before output mode, park the five other pins analog/no-pull, reset only the owned QUADSPI, require idle/reset readback, then disable its clock. Failed cleanup stops the core.
open_items: Physical timing, supply, IO continuity, real-device identity and silicon qualification.
No storage-array content, programming, endurance or power-loss qualification.
